scope: New registry/proposals/ entry (registry/proposals/flood_water_balance.json, PROP-FLOOD-03): one method-domain (M) proposal for a community flood-readout application (FloodConnect), via the governed proposals-lane intake process -- NOT promoted into registry/CANONICAL.json, which requires the full schema/lineage/checker workflow this entry has not gone through. PROP-FLOOD-03 is a finite water-balance readout for a bounded basin over one tick (S_b(k+1) = S_b(k) + P(k)*A_b*c_b + Q_in(k)*tau - Q_out(k)*tau, all on Q, given a required declared S_b(0)), with Q_out(k) := 0 if a declared gate_flag(k)=CLOSED else min(Q_out_meas(k), a declared pump capacity C_pump,b), total via an explicit REFUSED branch (reason in {MISSING_INPUT, STALE_INPUT, UNDECLARED_AREA, UNDECLARED_EDGE, NEGATIVE_STORAGE}) on any missing/stale/undeclared input or a computed negative storage, never a default or a silent clamp. It cites delta_R (instance_of), PROP-FLOOD-01 (sign readout -- this object's own S_b series read at lag 1 tick via PROP-FLOOD-01's unmodified construction, with REFUSED playing PROP-FLOOD-01's NO_READOUT role) and EQ-001/C.01.v1 (generalises -- the closed-boundary ledger-conservation reading is the degenerate case of this open-node object with gate_flag always CLOSED and no rain/inflow) as parents, all quoted/cited, not restated as new theorems. It is tier Dr / status unverified, carries an explicit claim_boundary/honest_caveats disclaiming any hydraulic/hydrological model content (no routing time, no infiltration model beyond a declared scalar folded into a Genesis-ledger obstructed term, no level<->volume curve, marks the stage-storage conversion OPEN) and any forecast claim, and empirical_test_status is 'none'. No claim about the Clay Millennium Navier-Stokes problem, or about any object's Clay/NS status, is made or implied anywhere in this change; the status of every existing Clay-related registry object (CANONICAL.json, coq/, docs/CLAY_*) is unchanged -- this PR touches no such object, only adds one new proposals-lane file.
